product_metadata.title: Yakamok Room Darkening Ombre Curtains 84 Inch Length, Purple and Greyish White Thermal Insulated Gradient Color Curtains,Light Blocking Grommet Window Drapes for Bedroom,52 Inch Width,2 Panels
features: ELEGANT DESIGN:2 panels per package.Each package includes two Gradient Curtain Panels of 52" wide x 84" length with 8 metal grommets each. The design of silver grommet (1.6-inch inner diameter) is easy to install and slide.These ombre curtains are soft and smooth.

SYMMETRICAL STYLE: The style of gradient curtains has a symmetrical beauty, and there are two ways to hang them. The fabrics of our curtains are very soft and smooth, and the exquisite printing patterns are composed of 2 different colors, creating a very elegant atmosphere.

MULTIPLE FUNCTIONS:These Ombre blackout curtains are made of 100% Polyester. Yakamok modern and ombre curtains provide privacy,block out 50%-70% sunlight and UV rays, reduce part of the noise,and meet the requirements of most families.
PREMIUM WORKMANSHIP:Our gradient curtains are made by premium workmanship. High quality stitch work, strictly control quality inspection to ensure no loose threads, all seams and hem aligned.
EASY CARE:Easy to maintain. Machine washable in cold water, tumble dry,use only non-chlorine bleach. Quick ironing or steam clean when needed.
